resources.string: FIDO2 / WebAuthn over FIDO Bluetooth LE

If pairing is stuck, open Bluetooth settings on both devices. Remove the saved PC pairing from the phone and the saved phone pairing from the PC (Windows may list the phone by its model name). Pair again and confirm the same number on both screens. Return here and tap Retry. Saved passkeys stay on the phone.
FIDO Bluetooth LE accepts connections initiated by the PC or other host. To start a request, choose Chimali from the host’s security key list.
